title: ASE Certification Practice Tests

ASE A6 Electrical Electronics Practice Test
43. The door locks in the circuit diagram above unlock only. There is no lock action when the switch is depressed. After replacing the door lock relay, there is still no door lock operation. Which of the following is MOST likely causing this condition?
- A. A faulty switch.
- B. The wrong type of relay.
- C. A blown 30 amp fuse.
- D. A faulty circuit breaker.
